The script's settings. Work happens on Contributor Feedback; nothing here needs you unless you install the script. Do not edit this tab: the agent writes it, except EDITORS, which only the owner edits.

Once per sheet, by the sheet's owner. Made with File, then Make a copy, of the template? It is already set up: choose Review links, then Install, allow it (step 5), and you are done. Otherwise (details: https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/blob/main/skills/content/folio-document-adapter/review-sheet-script.md#installing-the-script-step-by-step):
1. Get the short stub: open https://github.com/litlfred/folio-assistant-core/blob/main/tools/review-sheet-sync/dist/Stub.gs and press "Copy raw file" (the two-squares button at the top right of the code)
2. Here, choose Extensions, then Apps Script. Name the project after this sheet (click "Untitled project"). "Unable to open the file"? Use a private window signed in to the owner's account only
3. Click Code.gs, select all, delete, paste the stub and save (Ctrl+S or Cmd+S)
4. Next to Libraries, press +, paste the Script ID 1us7_ApIq_XvDG-V1XtqdcyHucF0hSlST0qracv1Tw9KTb4-lAFvK1bMQ, press Look up, choose Version HEAD (Development mode), set Identifier to Review, and press Add
5. Reload the sheet and choose Review links, then Install. Google asks to allow it, then says "Google hasn't verified this app. The app is requesting access to sensitive info in your Google Account." That is expected for a sheet's own script. Choose Advanced, then Go to <project name> (unsafe), then Allow. Why: https://support.google.com/cloud/answer/7454865
6. Review links, then Refresh now, checks it
   • Updates need nothing here: the code lives once in the Folio Review Library (https://script.google.com/home/projects/1us7_ApIq_XvDG-V1XtqdcyHucF0hSlST0qracv1Tw9KTb4-lAFvK1bMQ/edit), and every sheet runs its latest version

Once per sheet, after installing the script: allow several sections in the Selected Sections dropdown (the script cannot):
   • Click the column letter above "Selected Sections", then Data, then Data validation
   • Open the rule (it says "Dropdown (from a range)"), open Advanced options and set Display style to Chip
   • Then tick Allow multiple selections (it is greyed out until the style is Chip) and press Done

Who may set Ready for agent and Ready for merge: the emails in the orange EDITORS cell below (column B).
   • Share each of them as Editor first (Share button, pick Editor)
   • Type their emails in the EDITORS cell; only the owner can change it
   • Format: plain emails only, no names; one per line (Ctrl+Enter, or Cmd+Enter on a Mac, starts a new line in a cell). Commas or semicolons also work
   • Example, for two editors:
        ana@example.org
        ben@example.org
   • Anything that is not an email is left out, and Refresh now says which
   • Choose Review links, then Refresh now: the two Ready columns are locked to the owner plus them
   • Leave it empty and only the owner can set them (the default)
